name: Colorado River — Pumphouse to State Bridge
blurb: Upper Colorado below Gore Canyon: BLM Pumphouse and Radium fee sites, Class II–III Little Gore and Red Gorge, to Eagle County's State Bridge.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Little Gore Canyon. BLM fee sites at both ends. Mileage: BLM Upper Colorado River Guide (Pumphouse to Dotsero), 2015.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 90084
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 90084 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 9 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM fee site with three developed launch/take-out areas (guide RM 11.0). (BLM Upper Colorado River Guide (Pumphouse to Dotsero), 2015, https://rms.memberclicks.net/assets/NRRD/RiverGuides/Upper_Colorado_River_Guide_2015.pdf).
